summary: ONE_3PCT_SHOCK_DIAGNOSTIC_VERTICAL_SLICE_READY. Two contiguous, canonical, source-produced COMPLETE_UTC_DAY bundles provide the exact prior close, target close and 24-hour OHLCV path needed for the inclusive event abs((target_close/prior_close)-1)>=0.0300. The diagnostic is causally distinct from lagged-realized-volatility participation and the closed V2/V2B/V2C exit branches: it describes a completed shock without selecting a volatility estimator, entry, exit, direction, holding period, size or Trading action. The future-only deterministic record is hash-bound to both day artifacts and chain heads and contains day identities, closes, signed and absolute simple return, UP/DOWN direction, target open/high/low/close/volume, open gap, high/low excursions from prior close, 24 hourly incremental and cumulative close returns, earliest close-threshold crossing, earliest-tie peak/trough hours, largest absolute hourly return, first-12h and last-12h returns, hourly sign counts, close-in-range and largest-hour volume share. Causal explanation remains UNKNOWN unless a separately frozen source record includes immutable identity or URL, publication time, observed time, decision cutoff and confidence and was available by that cutoff. Factor-eligible episodes must be sealed after contract activation and before any post-shock outcome; earlier accepted days are context-only. The smallest integration is an idempotent logical child inside the existing heartbeat, after canonical day-reference validation and before event sorting/Coach delivery, using the existing Server Canonical writer and Coach outbox. No second timer, source, writer, LLM, news fetch, R1/R2 mutation, hypothesis, candidate or experiment is introduced. Immediate PnL and drawdown effect is zero.

checks.name: EXACT_UTC_DAY_EVENT
checks.evidence: Freeze exactly two contiguous complete source-produced UTC days and event=true iff abs((target UTC-day close/prior UTC-day close)-1)>=0.0300, inclusive. Rolling-24h, high-low, log-return and 2%/4% neighbors are excluded.

checks.name: FORWARD_DAY_SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY
checks.evidence: The frozen schema and validator require exactly 24 ordered complete 1H bars per UTC day, valid OHLCV, canonical normalization, source provenance, capture after close within deadline, contiguous day sequence, sealed artifact hashes and cumulative chain validation.

checks.name: DETERMINISTIC_PATH_FIELDS
checks.evidence: Freeze source/trigger/day/artifact/chain identities; prior and target closes; signed/absolute return and direction; target daily OHLCV; open/high/low excursions from prior close; 24 incremental and cumulative close returns; earliest close-threshold crossing; earliest-tie peak/trough; largest hourly absolute return; first/last 12h returns; sign counts; close-in-range with null on zero range; and earliest-tie largest-hour volume share.

checks.name: QUALITATIVE_COACH_BOUNDARY
checks.evidence: OHLCV may state when and how, never why. Unsupported cause is UNKNOWN. Any qualitative claim requires source identity or URL, published_at, observed_at, separately frozen decision_cutoff and confidence. Post-cutoff material is EDUCATIONAL_ONLY and cannot become factor evidence.

checks.name: POINT_IN_TIME_FACTOR_ELIGIBILITY
checks.evidence: Only episodes whose diagnostic was sealed after contract activation from already accepted day hashes and before any later outcome are eligible. Pre-contract episodes are CONTEXT_ONLY; point-in-time violations, changed hashes or noncontiguous days reject the episode.

checks.name: VOLATILITY_BRANCH_DISTINCTNESS
checks.evidence: Lagged-realized-volatility participation concerns a lagged admission/participation mechanism. V2 tested ATR targets/trails, V2B volatility-percentile exits and V2C reversal-confirmed ATR exits; all three are closed NO_CANDIDATE exit/action studies. This diagnostic changes no entry, exit, participation or closed conclusion.

checks.name: SINGLE_CLOCK_INTEGRATION
checks.evidence: The existing heartbeat already validates hash-backed canonical artifacts, sorts bounded events and advances the Coach delivery outbox. A future pure/idempotent shock child can run after accepted-day validation and before events.sort/_advance_coach_delivery, under the same heartbeat and Server Canonical writer.

checks.name: SAMPLE_AND_PROMOTION_GATES
checks.evidence: Before outcomes, freeze one accumulation window ending with the existing R1 window: at least 8 eligible shocks, at least 2 UP and 2 DOWN, at least 2 events in each chronological half, at least 3 UTC calendar months, no month above 50%, zero deterministic-field missingness, zero duplicate/point-in-time violations. Any qualitative-factor proposal additionally requires at least 75% point-in-time eligible sourced labels, UNKNOWN at most 25%, complete provenance for every non-UNKNOWN label and no attribution class above 50%. Failure closes without lowering 3% or extending the window.

checks.name: OPPORTUNITY_COST
checks.evidence: The bounded deterministic detector structures rare moves while R1/R2 mature. A daily LLM/news narrative would add cost, hindsight bias and false causal confidence; it is excluded. Waiting for sufficient episodes is preferred to threshold or window relaxation.

checks.name: PERFORMANCE_AND_OOS_VALUE
checks.evidence: Prediction, significance, fees, slippage, capacity, annual/regime breadth, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness and OOS value were not measured and cannot be inferred from this design.

checks.name: DEPLOYMENT_AND_CONTINUOUS_COVERAGE
checks.evidence: No implementation, deployed heartbeat child, continued evidence availability after the frozen R1 window, runtime liveness or operational capacity was inspected.

checks.name: ZERO_WRITE_AND_OUTCOME_BOUNDARY
checks.evidence: No current/new day, price, Local inbox/outbox, server state, OOS or unlisted outcome was accessed. No repository, research-state, canonical, schedule, source or Trading write occurred.
